articles.summary: Morningstar, Inc. (Nasdaq: MORN) reported growth in revenue, operating and adjusted operating income, and margins in the third quarter. "We continue to put important product enhancements in the hands of our clients while delivering profitable growth," said Morningstar CEO Kunal Kapoor. "This month, we launched Direct AI, which features agentic workflows backed by our trusted data, research, and analytics. As clients increasingly engage with our data within AI-driven workflows, we're also seeing strong adoption across our MCP offerings, with cumulative tool calls through the PitchBook Data Premium Connector surpassing 13 million in October, up from 1 million in July." The Company's quarterly shareholder letter available at shareholders.morningstar.com provides more context on its third-quarter results and business performance. Third-Quarter 2026 Financial Highlights Reported revenue increased 8.9% to $672.1 million compared to the prior-year period; organic revenue increased 6.8%.
articles.title: Morningstar, Inc. Reports Third-Quarter 2026 Financial Results

articles.summary: Administrative demands, harder-to-explain investments, and growing client expectations continue to compete for advisors’ time despite rapid AI adoption. Morningstar, Inc. (Nasdaq: MORN), a leading provider of independent investing insights, today released its annual Morningstar Investors Perspectives Advisor study, the third installment in the 2026 Morningstar Investor Perspectives series. Following research on retail investors and asset owners , the study provides new insight into how advisors are responding to AI adoption, rising client expectations, and market uncertainty. articles.title: Advisors Adopt AI Fast, but Still Aren’t Getting Their Time Back, Says 2026 Morningstar Investor Perspectives Advisor Study

articles.summary: Morningstar Public/Private Select Series combines Morningstar Wealth's portfolio construction and due diligence with streamlined implementation through Envestnet Morningstar (Nasdaq: MORN) today announced that its Morningstar Wealth division will make the Morningstar Public/Private Select Series available through Envestnet, giving financial advisors a streamlined way to implement professionally constructed portfolios spanning public and private markets. Announced earlier this year , the Morningstar Public/Private Select Series was developed by Morningstar Wealth in collaboration with Apollo, Franklin Templeton and J.P. Morgan Asset Management to bring complementary public and private market capabilities together within a single portfolio framework.
